04 / THE GITVORA PROCESS

From Repository to
Relevant Audience

01

UNDERSTAND

Study the repository, features, use case, audience and existing positioning.

02

IDENTIFY

Determine who is most likely to use, test, discuss, recommend or contribute to the project.

03

RESEARCH

Find the communities, platforms and distribution opportunities where those users spend time.

04

POSITION

Develop project-specific messaging based on the real value of the repository.

05

DISTRIBUTE

Introduce the project organically through suitable developer communities and channels.

06

MEASURE

Review engagement, feedback and repository activity to understand what is generating meaningful attention.

ABOUT GITVORA

Why Gitvora

Gitvora helps open-source maintainers and technical founders plan and carry out project-specific visibility campaigns. Work starts with the repository, its use case and the people it can help.

Project-Specific Outreach

Messaging, positioning and distribution angles are adapted to each repository, audience and use case.

Clear Campaign Scope

Research, channels and agreed deliverables give you a clear picture of what the campaign involves.
